title: Plan align-watchers lanes 3 to 7 and 9 land
why: Watchers plan align-watchers: one rule for watches, wakes, sweeps, reaps and logs.
note: Coordinator 14:56 CST, from lane watchers-one-rule (PR #1349), plan docs/plans/align-watchers.md on that branch.
